applicabilityBasis.summary: satUSD is marketed as a USD-pegged, transferable stablecoin minted from overcollateralized CDPs. Redemption delivers crypto collateral, subject to protocol conditions and fees. The opened terms do not establish a legal issuer obligation to deliver national currency or a bank deposit; payment-stablecoin applicability remains unclear.

references.label: GENIUS Act Public Law 119-27, payment stablecoin definition

genius.notes: The exact legal satUSD issuing entity and domicile were not established and are omitted. The River interface terms exclude U.S. and Canadian residents, with no express EU exclusion. Collateral redemption does not establish a monetary-value redemption obligation. No qualifying GENIUS intent or monthly independent reserve attestation was identified in the consulted disclosures. The pre-effective DASP enum describes only GENIUS timing, not permission under other laws.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, independently reopened token disclosures, federal proposal pages, the NYDFS directory and targeted token/operator searches did not identify a public qualifying GENIUS approval, state qualification, token-specific application or foreign registration for River satUSD. The exact legal token issuer remains unresolved. This public-source negative finding does not establish absence of unpublished filings or filings under an unidentified legal name.
